entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] [inst_2 : Fintype A] [inst_3 : Fintype B] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B] (G : QuantumParallelRepetition.Game X Y A B) (n : ℕ) (S : QuantumParallelRepetition.Strategy (G.repeat n)) (D : Finset (Fin n)) (xs : Fin n → X) (ys : Fin n → Y), ∑ α, ∑ β, QuantumParallelRepetition.fullQuestionWinIndicator G D xs ys α β * ((QuantumParallelRepetition.bornTracePairing S.state.matrix) (QuantumParallelRepetition.conditionedAliceEffect G n S D α xs)) (QuantumParallelRepetition.conditionedBobEffect G n S D β ys) = ∑ aa, ∑ bb, if ∀ (i : ↥D), G.predicate (xs ↑i) (ys ↑i) (aa ↑i) (bb ↑i) = true then S.outcomeProbability xs ys aa bb else 0

entries.name: QuantumParallelRepetition.conditionedEventDistribution_projection_relativeEntropy_le
entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_5} {κ : Type u_6} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype κ] (law : QuantumParallelRepetition.FiniteEventLaw Ω) (event : Finset Ω), 0 < law.eventMass event → ∀ (projection : Ω → κ), QuantumParallelRepetition.Pinsker.finiteRelativeEntropy (QuantumParallelRepetition.ClassicalInformation.groupedMass projection (QuantumParallelRepetition.conditionedEventDistribution law event)) (QuantumParallelRepetition.ClassicalInformation.groupedMass projection law.weight) ≤ Real.log (1 / law.eventMass event)

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_5} [inst : Fintype Ω] (law : QuantumParallelRepetition.FiniteEventLaw Ω) (event : Finset Ω), 0 < law.eventMass event → QuantumParallelRepetition.Pinsker.finiteRelativeEntropy (QuantumParallelRepetition.conditionedEventDistribution law event) law.weight = Real.log (1 / law.eventMass event)

entries.statement: ∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Ω] [inst_2 : Fintype ι] [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_4 : Fintype β] [inst_5 : DecidableEq β] (U : Ω → ι → ↥(Matrix.unitaryGroup β ℂ)) (ω ν : Ω) (q r : ι → β), ↑(QuantumParallelRepetition.controlledFiniteTensorLocalUnitary U) ⟨ω, q⟩ ⟨ν, r⟩ = if ω = ν then ∏ i, ↑(U ω i) (q i) (r i) else 0

entries.name: QuantumParallelRepetition.convexMixtureStrategy
entries.statement: {X : Type u_1} → {Y : Type u_2} → {A : Type u_3} → {B : Type u_4} → {J : Type} → [inst : Fintype X] → [inst_1 : Fintype Y] → [inst_2 : Fintype A] → [inst_3 : Fintype B] → [inst_4 : Fintype J] → [DecidableEq J] → {G : QuantumParallelRepetition.Game X Y A B} → (p : J → ℝ) → (∀ (j : J), 0 ≤ p j) → ∑ j, p j = 1 → (J → QuantumParallelRepetition.Strategy G) → QuantumParallelRepetition.Strategy G

entries.name: QuantumParallelRepetition.convexMixtureStrategy_outcomeProbability
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_4} {J : Type} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] [inst_2 : Fintype A] [inst_3 : Fintype B] [inst_4 : Fintype J] [inst_5 : DecidableEq J] {G : QuantumParallelRepetition.Game X Y A B} (p : J → ℝ) (hp : ∀ (j : J), 0 ≤ p j) (h_normalized : ∑ j, p j = 1) (S : J → QuantumParallelRepetition.Strategy G) (x : X) (y : Y) (a : A) (b : B), (QuantumParallelRepetition.convexMixtureStrategy p hp h_normalized S).outcomeProbability x y a b = ∑ j, p j * (S j).outcomeProbability x y a b

entries.name: QuantumParallelRepetition.convexMixtureStrategy_winProbability
entries.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_4} {J : Type} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : Fintype Y] [inst_2 : Fintype A] [inst_3 : Fintype B] [inst_4 : Fintype J] [inst_5 : DecidableEq J] {G : QuantumParallelRepetition.Game X Y A B} (p : J → ℝ) (hp : ∀ (j : J), 0 ≤ p j) (h_normalized : ∑ j, p j = 1) (S : J → QuantumParallelRepetition.Strategy G), (QuantumParallelRepetition.convexMixtureStrategy p hp h_normalized S).winProbability = ∑ j, p j * (S j).winProbability

entries.name: QuantumParallelRepetition.dSVActualGlobalMixedBornSuccess_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {κ : Type u_1} {d : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype κ] [inst_1 : Fintype d] [inst_2 : DecidableEq κ] [inst_3 : DecidableEq d] (τ : κ → ℝ) (k₀ : κ) (i₀ : d) (nonzero : τ k₀ ≠ 0) (P R : κ → Matrix d d ℂ) (hP : ∀ (k : κ), (P k).PosSemidef) (hPc : ∀ (k : κ), (1 - P k).PosSemidef) (hR : ∀ (k : κ), (R k).PosSemidef) (hRc : ∀ (k : κ), (1 - R k).PosSemidef), (∀ (k : κ), P k * P k = P k) → (∀ (k : κ), R k * R k = R k) → QuantumParallelRepetition.binaryJointSuccessProbability (QuantumParallelRepetition.pureDensityMatrix (QuantumParallelRepetition.sharedThresholdResource τ) ⋯) (QuantumParallelRepetition.dSVGlobalProjectorBinaryPOVM P hP hPc) (QuantumParallelRepetition.transposePOVM (QuantumParallelRepetition.dSVGlobalProjectorBinaryPOVM R hR hRc)) = (∑ k, τ k ^ 2 * (P k * R k).trace.re) / (↑(Fintype.card d) * ∑ k, τ k ^ 2)

entries.name: QuantumParallelRepetition.spectralPartitionPOVM_effect_eq_spectralDiagonal
entries.statement: ∀ {κ : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype κ] [inst_1 : DecidableEq κ] [inst_2 : Fintype ι] [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] (F : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (positive : F.PosSemidef) (bin : ι → κ) (outcome : κ), (QuantumParallelRepetition.spectralPartitionPOVM F positive bin).effect outcome = (QuantumParallelRepetition.spectralConjugationCLM ⋯.eigenvectorUnitary) (Matrix.diagonal fun i => if bin i = outcome then 1 else 0)

entries.name: QuantumParallelRepetition.spectralPartitionPOVM_trace_mul_eq_atom_overlap
entries.statement: ∀ {κ : Type u_1} {d : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype κ] [inst_1 : Fintype d] [inst_2 : DecidableEq κ] [inst_3 : DecidableEq d] (F G : Matrix d d ℂ) (hF : F.PosSemidef) (hG : G.PosSemidef) (binF binG : d → κ) (k : κ), ((QuantumParallelRepetition.spectralPartitionPOVM F hF binF).effect k * (QuantumParallelRepetition.spectralPartitionPOVM G hG binG).effect k).trace.re = ∑ i with binF i = k, ∑ j with binG j = k, QuantumParallelRepetition.spectralAtomOverlap F G hF hG i j

entries.name: QuantumParallelRepetition.spectralPartitionPOVM_weighted_trace_deficit_eq_mismatch
entries.statement: ∀ {κ : Type u_1} {d : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype κ] [inst_1 : Fintype d] [inst_2 : DecidableEq κ] [inst_3 : DecidableEq d] (F G : Matrix d d ℂ) (hF : F.PosSemidef) (hG : G.PosSemidef) (binF binG : d → κ) (τ : κ → ℝ), ∑ k, τ k ^ 2 * ((QuantumParallelRepetition.spectralPartitionPOVM G hG binG).effect k).trace.re - ∑ k, τ k ^ 2 * ((QuantumParallelRepetition.spectralPartitionPOVM F hF binF).effect k * (QuantumParallelRepetition.spectralPartitionPOVM G hG binG).effect k).trace.re = ∑ i, ∑ j, if binF i = binG j then 0 else τ (binG j) ^ 2 * QuantumParallelRepetition.spectralAtomOverlap F G hF hG i j
